::: notes
[advance] In Task 4 you ran three or four specifications, every one of them defensible, and watched the estimate move. [advance] Nothing about that is unusual or improper, and I say so plainly, because some of this literature takes a slightly accusatory tone that I do not think is deserved. Every analysis that any of us has published came from a space like the one in which you were working, and we reported one point from it and did not mention the rest, mostly because it did not occur to us that the rest could be reported. [advance] The multiverse idea is therefore a proposal about reporting rather than an accusation: the space is itself a finding, and one point shown without the space around it is incompletely reported.
:::
